Chapter 666: Chapter 8 Secret Realm Closure (5000 words, please subscribe)_2

“How could I possibly have any?” Sizhong Ancient God sighed. Even if he did have them, he wouldn’t bring them out.

…

Lin Yuan left the temporarily constructed virtual network world and returned to his personal space.

“This Tuoba Ancient God, he sees me as a fat sheep, ready to be slaughtered heavily,” Lin Yuan sat down and thought to himself.

Anyone could see that the conditions proposed by Tuoba Ancient God were too excessive, but he was indeed using Fang Qing’s Spirit Will as leverage against Lin Yuan.

“The intelligence reports described Tuoba Ancient God as proud and irritable. Now it seems, he also has quite the nerve,” Lin thought, daring to threaten him so blatantly.

...

Lin Yuan had hardly ever encountered such a situation.

It is true, Tuoba Ancient God has no need to fear me. In the eyes of most powerhouses, my limit is the Eleventh Rank, as for the ultimate? Stepping into the ultimate has nothing to do with talent or qualifications,” Lin Yuan thought. As an Eleventh Rank, Tuoba, a special life form, had no reason to fear an Eleventh Rank of human civilization.

As for Lin Yuan breaking various myths and creating miracles at the Eighth and Ninth Ranks?

With higher levels, achieving what he did at the Eighth and Ninth Ranks would become exponentially harder.

Could Lin Yuan, able to kill peers like slaughtering chickens at the Eighth and Ninth Ranks, still do so after ascending to the Eleventh Rank?

Killing an Eleventh Rank Powerhouse like slaughtering chickens, that was a method only a Supreme Being possessed. Even some special Eleventh-Rank Lives have some resistance against Supreme Beings.

For instance, the ‘Mother of the Tree Realm,’ definitely one of the strongest Eleventh-Rank Lives.

A moment later.

Sizhong Ancient God took the initiative to contact Lin Yuan.

“Galaxy Master, I’m sorry, I couldn’t persuade Tuoba.” Sizhong Ancient God said somewhat ashamed, he hadn’t expected Tuoba Ancient God to be so mad, proposing any kind of conditions.

“Tuoba has little lifespan left and will soon be forced to attempt the ultimate, grasping at any hope to boost his chance. At this time, when you see him…”

Sizhong Ancient God sighed.

If it were billions of years earlier, he would be confident enough to persuade Tuoba Ancient God by himself, but now? In Tuoba Ancient God’s eyes, only the ultimate mattered, even if it meant offending one or two Supreme Beings.

“I will continue to maneuver around this issue.”

“From what I know about Tuoba, his conditions could still be lowered,” Sizhong Ancient God said.

“Understood.”

“Troubling Sizhong Ancient God.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

…

After Sizhong Ancient God left.

Lin Yuan still sat in the same spot.

“The conditions could be even lower?”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly. From his brief interaction with Tuoba Ancient God, he felt the probability wasn’t very high.

Besides, starting with treasures that enhance the chance of reaching the ultimate, even if lowered, how much lower could they get?

…

Chikun Main Star.

Lin Yuan’s figure appeared silently.

From the Milky Way Main Star to the Chikun Main Star, it used to take one to two years during Lin Yuan’s Eighth Layer time.

But now controlling the “Nine Steps of Space-Time,” it was merely a matter of two or three steps for Lin Yuan.

Lin Yuan’s surrounding void twisted, easily evading the Planetary Defense System of Chikun Main Star, and everyone on the Chikun Main Star was unaware that the Galaxy Master had already returned.

Soon.

Lin Yuan returned to the Thirteen Peaks, familiar with the path.

He then entered Fang Qing’s cultivation chamber.

The incident of Fang Qing suddenly fainting had not yet been leaked. Lin Yuan’s contact with Tuoba Ancient God wasn’t to explain the reason, aside from Sizhong Ancient God, no one else knew.

“Fang Qing.”

Lin Yuan saw Fang Qing lying in the nutrient capsule.

Whoosh.

The apparition of an old man with white beard appeared. As an intelligent life, he could only project in this reality, lacking a physical body.

“Galaxy Master, how… how did you come back?” The white-bearded old man was shocked. He had just met the Galaxy Master not long ago and was waiting for the Galaxy Master’s notification, only for Lin Yuan to personally return?

“No need to make this known…”

Lin Yuan glanced at the white-bearded old man, “Regarding Fang Qing, I will ask a Supreme Being to casually resurrect him later.”

The next moment.

Lin Yuan’s thoughts fluctuated, and using Fang Qing’s body as a ‘medium,’ he followed the causal connection to curse kill his Spirit Will.

As Fang Qing had just entered the Sixth Rank, and Lin Yuan was a Ninth Rank Evolver, spanning three great realms, coupled with using the deepest linked physical body as ‘medium.’

It was certain that Fang Qing was doomed.

The causal rule is one of the most mysterious and obscure of the many rules within the universe. After stepping into the Ninth Rank, Lin Yuan specifically contemplated this rule for a period.

If Fang Qing’s Spirit Will were allowed to be substituted by Tuoba Ancient God for experience, Fang Qing’s memories would be completely contaminated by the Ancient God.

It’s akin to being deeply poisoned by memories.

Even if resurrected, if the memories remain unchanged, he would still die in madness.

Rather than that, Lin Yuan preferred to directly kill Fang Qing.

In such a death, Fang Qing still had a chance to be resurrected by a Supreme Being.

To increase the chance of a thorough kill on Fang Qing, Lin Yuan’s apparent response to Tuoba Ancient God was ‘I’ll consider it.’

To let the other party maintain hope, while in secret, his true self hurried back to Chikun Main Star, so that he could maximize the success rate of the cursed killing.

“The cause and effect have disappeared?”

After the cursed killing was completed, Lin Yuan sensed the causal line belonging to Fang Qing disappear.

Given the vast difference in their levels, this cursed killing did not cost Lin Yuan anything.

Actually, Lin Yuan was also prepared for the worst scenario, that of the cursed killing failing, given that the control of Fang Qing’s Spirit Will was in the hands of Tuoba Ancient God.

Such an ancient god, what means did he not possess? There might be a possibility of isolating causality.
